content.comment_body: I have a large project in [product_name] [version_no] and I'm running out of space for blocks. Is there a way to enlarge the workspace? I can share my project if necessary.
In the menu bar of the diagram editor, you'll see an icon labeled 'Page Layout'. Using this option allows you to select the number of vertical and horizontal pages in your workspace.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a limitation in the design area of [product_name] [version_no], where the default workspace was too small for a large project. The solution, located in the diagram editor, lets users increase workspace size by adjusting the page layout, although this feature may not be easily noticeable at first.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like an easy way to expand the workspace in [product_name] to accommodate large projects.
